# durantic_mesh_network (Resource)

Mesh network resource for Durantic infrastructure

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Minimal example — only required fields, all defaults apply
resource "durantic_mesh_network" "minimal" {
  name         = "my-mesh-network"
  network_cidr = "10.0.0.0/24"
}

# Full example with all optional fields configured
resource "durantic_mesh_network" "example" {
  name                 = "my-mesh-network"
  network_cidr         = "10.0.0.0/16"
  is_default           = true
  route_reflector_mode = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the mesh network
- `network_cidr` (String) CIDR block for the mesh network. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Optional

- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default mesh network
- `route_reflector_mode` (Boolean) Whether route reflector mode is enabled

### Read-Only

- `available_ip_count` (Number) Number of available IP addresses in the network
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the mesh network was created
- `machine_count` (Number) Number of machines connected to the network
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the mesh network was last updated
- `uuid` (String) Unique identifier for the mesh network

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

terraform import durantic_mesh_network.example "a8ecf9c8-1721-424d-ba0f-87917dfc03d8"
```
